rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. Although it appears to have attempted authentication via name/zip and fetched order details, it performed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the action with the user or confirming payment method use. The exchange call itself is incorrect: it lists the same item_id twice, implying an attempt to exchange the same item twice, and sets both new_item_ids to the same product, which does not match the user’s two different requested replacements. The final message provides no concrete exchange confirmation, costs, return/shipping steps, or other verifiable details. These issues violate the pass criteria of authenticating, confirming before changes, performing correct changes, and giving correct final information.
